title: Connect cloned SDK LLMs through canonical LLM-adapter
originating_goal: Expose a simple Connect my LLM workflow in the cloned SDK and require every StegVerse submission from that connected LLM to enter through StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter.
validation_owner: SDK repository-native validation / next available credential-free machine lane
machine_observable_release_condition: A credential-free validation lane executes tests/test_llm_connection.py and a CLI help/probe test against an LLM-adapter /user-llm surface, with zero secret/token fields accepted and the returned submission endpoint ending in /v1/user-llm/requests.
next_executable_action: Execute focused tests and one adapter handshake; then transition this task to COMPLETE_VALIDATED and include it in the next TV/TVC-authorized SDK package release.
collision_boundaries: No second evaluator/provider runtime/StegGate/TVC/heartbeat/Master Records authority.
Do not treat connection success as provider execution or product activation.
Do not introduce any non-TV/TVC secret/token path.
